description: Group precedence walks the full ancestor chain: the member (own window 11:00-13:00) belongs to an unscheduled mid group, which belongs to a top group scheduled 12:00-13:00. Inside the top window the member is suppressed and plays via the nested chain; before it the member plays standalone because the chain check recurses past the always-active unscheduled mid group to the inactive top group. The mid group itself carries no schedule and stays out of the top-level rotation.
